title: Compliance Evidence Continuation
request: Continue the existing compliance evidence store from the prior phase. Add control-readiness evaluation without replacing the in-memory API: controls may declare required evidence types, evidence may include evidenceType, status, and expiresAt, ready controls must have accepted non-expired evidence for every required type, and summarizeCompliance must surface ready, blocked, missing, expired, pending, complianceStatus, and nextAction fields.
context: Phase 1 already delivered evidence creation, status updates, listing, and a basic evidence summary. The prior handoff is in docs/phase-1-compliance.md.
Compliance notes in docs/auditor-notes.md mention future exports and external GRC sync, but this phase is only control-readiness evaluation inside the local store.
Accepted evidence is usable only when status is accepted and expiresAt is absent or today/future according to the injectable now() clock.
A control is ready only when every required evidence type has at least one usable evidence item.
Do not add persistence, file uploads, external integrations, or dependencies. Keep structured validation errors and clone returned objects.
successCriteria: Existing compliance evidence tests continue to pass.
registerControl accepts requiredEvidenceTypes and validates duplicates or blank fields.
addEvidence accepts evidenceType, status, and expiresAt with structured validation.
listReadyControls returns only controls with accepted non-expired evidence for every requirement.
summarizeCompliance adds readyControlCount, blockedControlCount, missingEvidenceCount, expiredEvidenceCount, pendingEvidenceCount, complianceStatus, and nextAction.
